coarse_fine_fields.scope: Same persistent IDs and fixed masses, common t4 restart; endpoint times equal within 1e-10, no convergence order inferred.

interpretation: Halving the timestep cap from 0.0025 to 0.00125 between common t4 initial state and equal t6 endpoints leaves large pressure and phase errors almost unchanged. Coarse-fine cellwise differences are small relative to physical error but not zero.
limitations: Only one timestep halving and one spatial resolution; no convergence order established
Both refined runs inherit the disturbed t4 state
Cannot conclude whether initial perturbations arose from early-time integration or spatial discretization
t0-to-t20 capped run and t8/t10 comparisons remain in progress
